title: Hyaluronic acid background biology (five-reference bundle)

product: Hyaluronic acid as a molecule — NOT a botiss product
supports: General HA biology only: immunomodulation, fibroblast proliferation, collagen production, blood vessel formation and early soft tissue healing.
